releases.notes:
## Changes

- Fixed the generated-slot book insertion paths that could apply enchantments without consuming the carried book, allowing repeated level increases ([#25](https://github.com/HatanoKawa/EnchantmentCustomTable/issues/25)). Split books also retain the correct remaining enchantment level when removed and put back.
- Fixed conversion-table payment persistence so consumed books and emeralds do not return after saving and reloading.
- Fixed Fabric copy generation running on the client, which could make material counts appear to disappear or become inconsistent with the server.
- Added Minecraft **26.3** support for Fabric and NeoForge, including its rendering, block and item-drop API changes.
- Applied the relevant fixes and regression checks to the separate **1.18.2, 1.19.2 and 1.20.1** Fabric/Forge branches.

## Downloads

This release contains **38 mod JARs**. Choose one matching both your Minecraft version and loader.

| Minecraft versions | Loaders | Java |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1.18.2, 1.19.2, 1.20.1 | Fabric / Forge | 17 |
| 1.21.1 through 1.21.11 | Fabric / NeoForge | 21 |
| 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2, 26.3 | Fabric / NeoForge | 25 |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains checksums for the JARs and `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json`. The manifest records each artifact's version, loader, source commit and checksum.

## Verification

- All four source branches passed local `buildReleaseArtifacts`, using Gradle's normal incremental checks. The complete 38-JAR set was checked for ZIP integrity, embedded version and target metadata, Java bytecode version and checksums.
- Actual GUI regression covered the mainline version matrix with full or quick suites, and both loaders of each legacy branch. Minecraft 26.3 has cumulative 30/30 checks passing on each loader, plus the strict Shift extension; reused historical checks are identified in the [full report](https://github.com/HatanoKawa/EnchantmentCustomTable/blob/a9269ccea6866b5da23ae3ff352e4fd5b3cd6dcd/tools/gui-validation/full-26.3-2026-09-27.md).
- The reported Forge 1.20.1 split/reinsert scenario was verified through three GUI cycles of Looting III → II → III, with the returned book consumed correctly. [Legacy verification](https://github.com/HatanoKawa/EnchantmentCustomTable/blob/fab3d786f76e7ed85899e91e7888cde4500d4e7a/tools/gui-validation/round4-2026-09-23.md).
- Forge 1.18.2 GUI checks on Apple Silicon used an ARM test runtime; they do not certify the original Intel native runtime. Published JARs retain the normal project dependencies. Multiplayer, full modpack compatibility and stress scenarios were not covered by this GUI suite.

## Known issues

- Some upgrades between **different Minecraft versions** can lose table inventory or stored enchantment components. Migration fixes remain deferred. Back up your world and remove items from the tables before upgrading Minecraft; same-version save/reload checks do not establish cross-version migration safety.
- On NeoForge 1.21.9 with NeoForge 21.9.16-beta, opening the Mods list may crash before this mod's configuration screen is reached. Edit the common config file directly if affected.
- On 26.3, an empty enchanting-table candidate page can display `-/-` immediately after export and `1/1` after reopening. The tested item counts and enchantments remain unchanged; this display inconsistency is still tracked.

## Source revisions

The `2.0.2` tag points to the mainline source. Legacy JARs are built from their separate branches; GitHub's automatic source archive contains the mainline only.

| Source | Commit |
| --- | --- |
| dev — mainline Fabric / NeoForge | [a9269cc](https://github.com/HatanoKawa/EnchantmentCustomTable/commit/a9269ccea6866b5da23ae3ff352e4fd5b3cd6dcd) |
| codex/port-1.18.2 — Fabric / Forge | [700337d](https://github.com/HatanoKawa/EnchantmentCustomTable/commit/700337dd8a4e246fd04ed6727940b07631e3f043) |

releases.notes:
## Summary

- Added `freeConversionTableCosts`.
  - When enabled, the enchantment conversion table can generate and copy enchanted books for free.
  - The normal book slot and payment slot stop accepting input in this mode.
  - Manual generated-book pickup and automation extraction from the copy output slot still work normally.
- Added Minecraft `26.2`, `1.19.2`, `1.18.2` support for both NeoForge and Fabric.
- Fixed a Minecraft `1.20.1` split-book issue where taking a generated split book could incorrectly leave copied enchantment data behind.
- Fixed Minecraft `1.20.1` Forge in-game config access so config values can be edited from the game and hot-reloaded.
- Completed several Minecraft `1.20.1` resource and loader compatibility adjustments, including GUI texture paths, resource pack metadata, Forge menu translations, and block-atlas stitching.

## Known issue

On NeoForge 1.21.9, opening the in-game Mods list may crash because of an issue in NeoForge 21.9.16-beta. Users affected by this can edit the common config file directly.

- A multi-version matrix for NeoForge and Fabric.

- Build, CI, and release artifact workflow changes.
